issues.text: Wrong option d is not clearly wrong at stage-2. The key is optional ("string? idempotencyKey = null") and stage-2 DonHang.App/lib/api_client.dart sends no Idempotency-Key (later code: "From stage-3 every order carries an Idempotency-Key"). A double click at stage-2 creates two orders, so d's dismissal ("finds nothing") and the key's "the job has nothing to fix" are unsupported.
issues.quote: Here it costs support time every day and finds nothing, because retries that carry an `Idempotency-Key` are caught before a second order exists
issues.fix: Replace option d (en+vi) with a clearly wrong one, e.g. "Delete the order with the higher `Id`, because two orders in one minute must be a double click." (misconception: "Two orders with the same customer, items and time are the same order.") plus a matching explanation. In the correct explanation replace "so the job has nothing to fix" with "so the job cannot tell them apart by data and must not merge or delete either".

issues.text: Explanation of d gives a false reason. d requires equal `PlacedAt`, which comes from DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, so two look-alike orders would not pass. d's premise is also false: `Version` (xmin) changes with the update, so `Status` is not the only difference. The key (a) stays correct.
issues.quote: two look-alike orders would pass this check
issues.fix: Replace the d explanation (en+vi) with: "This looks careful because it allows for the status change. But it still decides sameness by comparing data, and the lesson's point is that an order is named by its `Id`, not by which fields happen to match."
